description: Attack log + free-cumulant framing of the open covariance kernel Cov_Planch(f^λ, Σ_□c(□)²) ≤ 0 (residual gap of the Δ_λ growth bound #3939/#3959). Records why elementary approaches fail: per-λ sign false (row→+1); undivided Σχ³ is not a connection-coefficient count (no positivity model); |χ³/f^λ|≤1 attained at extremes (no uniform bound).
